about: Query vectors for the waveform tool.
Authored in canopy (tests/canopy_mcp/fixtures/workspace/); every other holder keeps a byte-identical copy of the whole directory.
ASCII-only, no trailing whitespace, exactly one final newline.
Every query is copied verbatim from react-trace's query tests at d52a7b9 (test: '<describe> > <it>'); a query a test builds from constants or a template is written out as the string the test builds.
verdict is what a command carrying the query as open_tool.query or set_query.query gets:
invalid_command: the hub refuses the batch (the query is over 4096 UTF-8 bytes; the hub's only query bound).
invalid_args: the viewer rejects the command (the tool's query grammar, its PV cap, or Trace's range).
accepted: the command is applied; the tool's page falls back to its default for any key it cannot read.

The viewer's rules: the query is decodable (every '&'-separated key and value survives decodeURIComponent); the distinct values of the tool's PV key (trace pv, correlation y, waveform pv; read as URLSearchParams does, '+' a space), blank ones not counted, number at most maxPvs.
